name: ping
title: Ping
description: Health check. Echoes a message back with the server name and version.

message.description: Text echoed back by the server.

name: calculate_rice
title: Calculate RICE scores
description: Score initiatives with RICE = (reach × impact × confidence) / effort and rank them. Deterministic; ties break by lower effort, then id. Use this instead of computing scores yourself.

effort.description: Person-months by default; also used for capacity

path.description: Path inside one of the configured allowedRoots

strict.description: false: items with missing fields are excluded with a warning

name: calculate_wsjf
title: Calculate WSJF scores
description: Score initiatives with WSJF = (business value + time criticality + risk reduction/opportunity) / job size (modified Fibonacci 1–20) and rank them. Deterministic; ties break by smaller job size, then id.

effort.description: Person-months by default; also used for capacity

path.description: Path inside one of the configured allowedRoots

normalize.description: Rescale each component so its smallest value in the set is 1 (SAFe relative estimation)

name: compare_initiatives
title: Compare prioritization methods
description: Rank the same initiatives with 2–3 methods (RICE, WSJF, CUSTOM weights) and report how much they agree (Kendall tau, top-N overlap), which items they disagree on and why (HIGH_/LOW_ component drivers).

effort.description: Person-months by default; also used for capacity

path.description: Path inside one of the configured allowedRoots

custom.description: Weighted sum of min-max normalized fields

kendallTau.description: Mean pairwise Kendall tau: 1 identical order, 0 unrelated, −1 reversed

topNOverlap.description: Mean share of top-N shared between methods

name: simulate_capacity
title: Simulate capacity scenarios
description: Fit ranked initiatives into team capacity and compare up to 5 what-if scenarios (fewer people, underestimated effort, forced in/out). Greedy by rank: mandatory items first, dependencies pulled in together, every deferred item gets a reason.

effort.description: Person-months by default; also used for capacity

path.description: Path inside one of the configured allowedRoots

custom.description: Weighted sum of min-max normalized fields

team.description: Team name, or "*" for a shared pool

name: explain_ranking
title: Explain a ranking
description: Explain why specific initiatives rank where they do: which components push them up or down versus a median item, and the smallest single-component change that would move them past a neighbour (verified by re-ranking). Use this output for trade-off explanations instead of reasoning about the numbers yourself.

effort.description: Person-months by default; also used for capacity

path.description: Path inside one of the configured allowedRoots

compareWith.description: neighbors: items ranked just above and below; top1: the #1 item

vsMedian.description: ln(value / set median); positive = pushes the score up

logShare.description: Share of this component in the distance from a median item
